title: Code Segment After Two Expressions
statement: Let $code$ be a finite instruction list, $pos$ a natural-number position, $a,b$ expressions, and $rest$ an instruction list. If the concatenation of the compiled code for $a$ at temporary index $0$, the compiled code for $b$ at temporary index $1$, and $rest$ is a prefix of the code beginning at $pos$, then $rest$ is a prefix of the code beginning at $pos+\mathrm{size}(a)+\mathrm{size}(b)$.
hypotheses_covered: The concatenated compiled code for $a$, $b$, and $rest$ is a prefix of the code beginning at $pos$
